## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/layer-o-living-board`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/layer-o-living-board -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `checks.csv`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

# Layer O living board: where councilof.ai is, read live (2026-10-18)

A daily presence-and-measurement dataset about **our own distribution**: the catalogs, indexes, registries and
archives where the Council of AI (councilof.ai, CSOAI Ltd) publishes, or could publish, and what a live public read
shows there today. It is **not** a GSPC model axis. It **ranks nothing** and scores no one. A surface appearing here
says only what that surface's own public page or API returned to a read-only GET.

## What is measured

- `surfaces.csv` / `surfaces.jsonl`: one row per surface in the Layer O registry: `state`, `state_since`,
  `presence` (MEASURED or UNMEASURED), `observed` (how many of our artifacts the live read showed; empty when
  UNMEASURED), `as_of`, and two hashes: `state_event_hash` (the hash-chained registry event behind the state) and
  `presence_evidence_sha256` (sha256 of the bytes read).
- `checks.csv` / `checks.jsonl`: every deck-lang statement run on 2026-10-18 against these surfaces (hourly
  read-only checks: HTTP status, JSON fields, presence counts): verdict, observed value, read time, evidence hash,
  receipt hash.
- `chain.json`: counts, and the heads of the registry event chain and of each deck receipt chain, so anyone
  holding an earlier copy can check that nothing was rewritten.

Today: **137 surfaces**, 67 MEASURED, 70 UNMEASURED; 834 checks.
Not published (HELD): audit_target (108), vendor_marketplace (22).

## States

DISCOVERED, QUALIFIED, READY, AUTH_REQUIRED, BUILDING, CONNECTED, PUBLISHED, SUBMITTED, UNDER_REVIEW, ACCEPTED,
REJECTED, BLOCKED, STALE, NEEDS_UPDATE, UNSUPPORTED. PUBLISHED, CONNECTED and ACCEPTED are set only by a live public
read that showed our artifact (URL + sha256 recorded). A note, an email or a memory never sets them.

## UNMEASURED

**UNMEASURED means we could not see, not that we are absent.** A 401/403, a JavaScript-only page, a partial sitemap
or a read path we have not got is UNMEASURED and stays UNMEASURED until a live read settles it. A check verdict of
UNMEASURED means the read did not complete. OBSERVED means a value was recorded with no assertion (never a PASS).

## Method

Read-only GETs with a named user agent (`csoai-layer-o-registry/0.1`), robots.txt respected. We store only our own
measurement plus the source URL and the sha256 of the bytes read, never a copy of a third party's record.
The same snapshot is published daily, as a new version, to Hugging Face (`csoai/layer-o-living-board`) and Kaggle
(`nicktempleman/layer-o-living-board`), and each mirror is itself a watched surface in this board.

## Licence

CC-BY-4.0 (this dataset: our measurements). Third-party names and URLs are facts of where we read.

## How to cite

Council of AI (CSOAI Ltd). *Layer O living board: councilof.ai distribution presence*, snapshot 2026-10-18.
Hugging Face dataset `csoai/layer-o-living-board`, https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/layer-o-living-board. CC-BY-4.0.

## Corrections

If a row is wrong about your surface, tell us: https://councilof.ai/corrections (or open a discussion on the
Hugging Face dataset). Corrections are applied by a new live read, recorded as a new hash-chained event; nothing is
edited in place.

## Dataset facts (checked 2026-11-20)

- Kaggle version 18, last updated 2026-10-18.
- 7 files, 726,347 bytes. File types: .csv (2), .jsonl (2), .md (1), (none) (1), .json (1).
- Expected update frequency: never.
